How to survive
  • 1Each question shows numbered options. Write your number on your card.
  • 2When time's up, everyone flips their card at the same time.
  • 3Then Ghady's answer is revealed. Match Ghady and you're out.
  • 4Options shrink every round. The last question is a 50/50.
  • 5If every remaining player matches Ghady, everyone survives that round.
